activities.title: Introduction to d3m0n Layouts
activities.value:
d3m0n os app system uses a efficient and flexible layout system to design the user interface of applications. It is designed to be simple and powerful, allowing developers to create user interfaces with minimal effort. They allow you to create static only (no animations) complex layouts with ease, using a simple and intuitive Framework.

In this course, we will cover the basics of the d3m0n layout system and how to use the App API to interact with it.

Let's embark on this exciting journey to master application design on d3m0n OS!
To continue to the next chapter, you need to complete the quiz. This is important to ensure that you have understood the concepts covered in this chapter.

courses.name: Understanding Basic Layout Elements and Classes of Controls
courses.description: Learn the basics layout elements to make your future d3m0n Application.

activities.title: Basic Layout Elements
activities.value: d3m0n layout system provides a set of basic elements that can be used to create user interfaces. These elements can be stored in a file with the extension .layout and placed in a directory called layouts

activities.title: Create Your First Application
activities.value: To create your first application, you need to create a new folder anywhere in your computer and create a new file in it without extension called app inside it. This file will contain the app's informations.

You can now put this inside the app file to make your first application:

name is the name of your application,
package is the package name of your application: should be unique,
icon is the path to the icon of your application,
perms is the permissions required by your application,
start_path is the path where your application will start,
category is the category of your application.

name: myApp
package: com.myteam.myApp
icon: default
perms: none
start_path: ~
category: tests

Now you can create a new file called main.layout in a new folder called layouts.
This is now the structure of your application:

myAppDirectory/
├── app
└── layouts/
       └── main.layout


The main.layout file will contain the layout of your application. You can use the following code to create a simple layout with a red rectangle on the left side of the screen:

As you can see, the layout is defined using a simple syntax. The Window element defines the main window of the application, and the Rect element defines a rectangle that will be displayed on the left side of the screen.

Properties of the elements are defined using the name="value"; syntax, where name is the name of the property and value is the value of the property.
Here is a list of the Controls that can be used in d3m0n layout elements:
  • TextBox: A text input box.
  • ListView: A control to show a list of items.
  • ProgressBar: A bar that can used to select a number between min and max defined by user.
  • CheckBox: A simple check switch with two states (on and off).
  • RadioButton: A simple on and off switch but once you clicked you cannot remove it => for single choice inputs.
  • RawHtml (⚠️ don't work): A simple HTML display for custom controls.
  • WebView (⚠️ don't work): A simple web browser.
  • Rect: A rectangle.
  • Switch: A on and off switch.
  • Text: A simple text.
  • Image: A simple rect where you can display your images.
  • RoundButton: A regular button but with round corners.
  • Button: A simple button.
  • Hscroll: A horizontal rect with a scroll bar.
  • Vscroll: A vertical rect with a scroll bar.

More infos about these controls can be found in the documentation

courses.name: Running Your First Application
courses.description: You have created your first application, now you will learn how to run it.

activities.title: Running Your First Application
activities.value:
To run your first application, you first need to create a executable application file.
This file can be simply created by zipping the app and the layouts folder together.
Then rename the file to somthing like changeMe.d3m0n

That's it! You can now run your application by uploading on your d3m0n device and put it in the applications directory.
Now you can run your application by clicking on it in the d3m0n OS menu!!


You can also run your application by using the d3m0n App Studio or the Device Emulator to test your app's layout in the d3m0n OS.

Just import your layout file and it will show you what it will look like in the d3m0n OS.

Making applications layouts is nice but without a live rendering it's harder to do so you can use the No Code App Studio to create unique designs.
Just drag and drop the controls you want to use and then edit their properties in the right panel.

courses.description: Learn the basics of the d3m0n scripting system and how to interract with the layout.

activities.title: Introduction to d3m0n Scripting
activities.value: Design is cool but it's only static so scripting is the way to make your application dynamic and interactive. In this course, we will cover the basics of the d3m0n scripting system and how to use the App API to interact with it.

All you app scripts should start with the header '# d3m0n source' to be recognized by the d3m0n system. This is important to avoid conflicts with other scripts and to ensure that your app runs correctly.
